boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Niagara University rituals and recurring campus practices, from welcome-week photographs to Vincentian observances.

cards.title: Purple-shirt welcome photo
cards.subtitle: New Student Orientation · O’Shea Hall Quad
cards.notes: Join your assigned orientation group for the large new-student photo, using the provided purple Niagara shirt as directed in the schedule.
cards.short_summary: A documented welcome-week group-photo tradition for incoming students.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara’s 2024 new-student orientation schedule calls the O’Shea Hall Quad group photo a Niagara tradition and says participants receive a free purple Niagara T-shirt.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation 2024 Schedule of Events
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of new-student orientation; consult the current orientation schedule for participation details.

cards.title: A week for the Vincentian identity
cards.subtitle: Annual observance around Sept. 27
cards.notes: Use the week’s published program to choose a lecture, service activity, reflection, or liturgy that fits your interests and schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Niagara-specific annual celebration of the university’s Vincentian identity.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara identifies Vincentian Heritage Week, held around the Sept. 27 feast day of St. Vincent de Paul, as a university tradition.
cards.access_notes: Dates and individual activities vary by year; check Niagara Mission’s current Heritage Week program.

cards.entity_name: Prayer of the Liturgy of the Hours
cards.title: Heritage Week’s opening prayer
cards.subtitle: Alumni Chapel · Vincentian Heritage Week
cards.notes: Attend the scheduled Alumni Chapel instruction and Liturgy of the Hours prayer if you would like a reflective start to Heritage Week.
cards.short_summary: A programmed prayer observance during Niagara’s annual Heritage Week.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara’s 2025 Heritage Week program opened with instruction and the Liturgy of the Hours for the Solemnity of St. Vincent de Paul in Alumni Chapel.
cards.access_notes: This is a faith-based observance; consult the current Heritage Week schedule for date and access details.

cards.title: Convocation honors Vincentian service
cards.subtitle: Alumni Chapel · Vincentian Heritage Week
cards.notes: Look for the annual convocation program to hear honorees recognized for living the Vincentian mission and to learn the year’s theme.
cards.short_summary: The signature recognition event of Niagara’s annual Heritage Week.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara describes the Vincentian Heritage Convocation as Heritage Week’s signature event and honors people for living the Vincentian mission.
cards.source_title: Hope Is Theme of Niagara University’s Annual Vincentian Heritage Week Celebration
cards.access_notes: Held during Heritage Week; verify the current year’s time, location, and attendance details.

cards.entity_name: Mass of the Solemnity of St. Vincent de Paul
cards.title: Feast-day Mass at Alumni Chapel
cards.subtitle: Alumni Chapel · Heritage Week Friday
cards.notes: If you wish to observe the feast day, use the current Heritage Week listing to confirm the chapel Mass time before going.
cards.short_summary: A Heritage Week Mass centered on Niagara’s patron saint.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara’s 2025 Heritage Week schedule included a Mass of the Solemnity of St. Vincent de Paul in Alumni Chapel.
cards.source_title: Hope Is Theme of Niagara University’s Annual Vincentian Heritage Week Celebration
cards.access_notes: Faith-based observance; consult the current program because times and arrangements may change.

cards.title: Take the Heritage Week walk
cards.subtitle: Grand Island · with the St. Vincent de Paul Society
cards.notes: Follow the current Heritage Week information for registration, transportation, and the service partner’s participation guidance before joining.
cards.short_summary: A service-oriented Heritage Week activity connected to the St. Vincent de Paul Society.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara’s 2025 Heritage Week program listed community participation in the Friends of the Poor Walk on Grand Island with the St. Vincent de Paul Society.
cards.source_title: Hope Is Theme of Niagara University’s Annual Vincentian Heritage Week Celebration
cards.access_notes: Off-campus activity; verify current logistics and participation requirements with the published Heritage Week program.

cards.title: Family Day pin presentation
cards.subtitle: Family Day Mass · Alumni Chapel
cards.notes: Watch the current Family Day Mass announcement for the Vincentian Scholars’ commemorative-pin presentation and attendance information.
cards.short_summary: A Family Day Mass recognition for Niagara’s incoming Vincentian Scholars.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara’s 2025 Heritage Week program said the new class of Vincentian Scholars would receive commemorative pins during Family Day Mass.
cards.source_title: Hope Is Theme of Niagara University’s Annual Vincentian Heritage Week Celebration
cards.access_notes: Recognition is for the Vincentian Scholars class; verify current Family Day Mass details before attending.

cards.title: End the year by presenting research
cards.subtitle: UGGRC · Honors Program
cards.notes: If you have a research project, ask your faculty mentor or the Honors Program about poster and panel presentation opportunities.
cards.short_summary: An end-of-year research-presentation tradition for Niagara undergraduates.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara calls the Undergraduate and Graduate Research Conference an annual end-of-school-year tradition in which undergraduates present scholarly research.
cards.source_title: Students Present for 2026 Undergraduate and Graduate Research Conference
cards.access_notes: Presentation formats and eligibility are set each year; contact the Honors Program or a faculty mentor for current details.

cards.entity_name: Meet the Accounting & Business Professionals Night
cards.title: A 50-year networking night
cards.subtitle: Holzschuh College of Business Administration
cards.notes: Prepare questions and check the career center’s current event details if you are eligible to meet alumni and participating employers.
cards.short_summary: A long-running annual gathering linking Niagara business students, alumni, and employers.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara reported that its annual Meet the Accounting & Business Professionals Night had brought accounting and business students, alumni, and employers together for 50 years.
cards.source_title: Niagara University Celebrates 50th Annual Meet the Accounting & Business Professionals Night
cards.access_notes: Program is geared to accounting and business students; confirm eligibility, date, and location with the college or career center.

cards.title: The archival “Old Niagara” song
cards.subtitle: Niagara University historical song
cards.notes: Read the university archive’s lyrics as a historical artifact of campus identity; treat its language as a record of its era.
cards.short_summary: A Niagara-specific historical college song preserved in the university archive.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University’s digitized historical archive preserves the song “Old Niagara,” whose refrain celebrates “Old Niagara” and its scenery.
cards.source_title: Our Golden Jubilee, Chapter XXII: Organizations
cards.access_notes: Historical archival material rather than a confirmed current event; access it online through Niagara’s digitized archive.
